subtitle: Spectral Harmonic Shifter
tagline: Tracks the fundamental, isolates the harmonic series, and moves it, or only the harmonics above the fundamental, to a new pitch while the timing stays intact.

body.lead: TB Step Shifter is a spectral harmonic shifter. Instead of resampling the whole spectrum, it tracks the input's fundamental frequency, isolates the harmonic series, and moves selected harmonics to new positions while the timing of the source stays the same.

body.p: In PITCH SHIFT mode the detected harmonic series moves to the new pitch. In COLORIZE mode the fundamental stays in place and the harmonics above it are retuned, which changes the tonal identity without changing the note. `STEP` sets how much of the series moves, and `MIX` blends the latency-aligned dry signal with the result. It works best on clearly pitched material such as vocals, acoustic guitar, and pads.

ul: PITCH SHIFT mode moves the detected harmonic series
COLORIZE mode keeps the fundamental and retunes the harmonics above it
`STEP` chooses how much of the series moves, from the lowest harmonics to the whole series
`RESOLUTION`: Fast for transients, Fine for low fundamentals, with the same reported latency
`MIX` blends the latency-aligned dry signal with the result
7 factory presets, user presets, undo, and redo

steps: Shift or retune, scaled by STEP
MIX with the aligned dry signal

note.title: About this manual
text: This manual describes TB Step Shifter 2.2.0 for Windows (VST3), which is published as a beta. The current macOS build is version 1.0.2 and may differ from the descriptions here.

ol: Insert TB Step Shifter on a clearly pitched source such as a vocal, acoustic guitar, or pad. The defaults are PITCH SHIFT mode, `PITCH` +12 st, `STEP` 50%, `RESOLUTION` Fast, and `MIX` 100%.
Choose PITCH SHIFT {{2}} to move the note, or COLORIZE to keep the note and change its colour.
Set `STEP` {{4}}. Low values move only the lowest harmonics; high values move the whole series.
If low notes track poorly, switch `RESOLUTION` {{5}} to Fine.

rows: Pitch Shift moves the detected harmonic series to the new pitch. Colorize keeps the fundamental in place and retunes the harmonics above it.
How far the harmonics are moved, in semitones. 0 st leaves the signal untouched.
How much of the detected harmonic series is shifted. Low values move only the lowest harmonics; high values move the whole series.
Analysis window length. Fast reacts more quickly to transients; Fine resolves low fundamentals more accurately. The reported latency is the same for both.
Blend between the latency-aligned dry signal and the shifted result. 100% is fully wet.

tip.text: Large shifts make processing artifacts more audible. For natural results, keep PITCH moderate or lower MIX; for effects, push both.

body.p: Use the arrows to step through presets, or open the list to choose a FACTORY or USER preset. Save stores the current settings as a .tbstepshifter file. The name shows CUSTOM after you change a setting. Undo and Redo step through recent changes.
Starting points for common jobs. Adjust them by ear.

recipes.title: Octave double
recipes.use: A clean octave layer above a vocal or lead.
steps: Lower MIX until the octave supports the line instead of competing with it.

recipes.title: Weight under a synth
recipes.use: A lower harmonic layer under a pad or lead.
steps: Check the low end in mono and on small speakers.

recipes.title: Glassy vocal colour
recipes.use: A new tone without changing the melody.
steps: Colorize keeps the note, so the melody stays in tune.

recipes.title: Warm patina
recipes.use: A darker, softer colour on guitar or keys.
steps: Raise STEP slowly; more harmonics move as it rises.
